data.application_guideline:
出國研修期間須繳交逢甲大學全額學雜費。
Students must pay full tuition and fees of Feng Chia University during their study abroad period.

國際或大陸地區，僅能擇一申請；校級雙聯或校級交換，亦僅能擇一申請。
For International or Mainland China regions, only one region can be applied. For dual-degree or exchange programs, only one cooperation type can be chosen.

本期僅可申請一學期（2027年2月至2027年7月），具體研修期程以姐妹校簡章或公告為準。
Only one-semester applications (from February 2027 to July 2027) are available during this period. The exact study period is subject to the partner university's official guidelines or announcements.

大陸地區姊妹校簡章僅提供上期開放狀況供參考，無法保證各校後續是否會開放本期申請，招收資訊與相關規定以姊妹校最新公告簡章為準；若因簡章更新致使學生無法申請，國際處將協助學生申請其他合適之姊妹校。
The brochure only provides the status of Mainland China partner universities' availability from the previous term for reference. It cannot guarantee whether the schools will open applications for the current term. The admission information and related regulations are subject to the latest announcements and brochures from the universities. If updates to the guidelines prevent students from applying, the Office of International Affairs will assist in exploring alternative partner universities.

115-1 出國研修申請重要時程：
Important Dates for applying Study Abroad Program in the 115-1 Academic Year:

即日起至2026年8月10日－瀏覽研修資訊
From now till August 10, 2026: Browse application information.

2026年7月27日至8月10日下午五點－提出研修申請
July 27 - August 10, 2025, by 5:00 PM: Submit the online application and required materials.

預計2026年9月下旬－公告校內初審錄取名單
Expected in end of September, 2026 : Announcement of preliminary admission list.

依各姊妹校規定時程－提交姊妹校複審資料及錄取
In accordance with each partner universities’ regulations: Submit re-evaluation materials and admission confirmation.
